info.title: Go CRUD API
info.description: JSON API written in Go without HTTP frameworks. Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB by default; exceeding the limit returns 413. Idempotency keys are bound to the HTTP method, request URI, body, and user; reuse for a different request returns 409.

204.description: Monitor resumed. The response body is empty, including an idempotent replay.

409.description: Monitor cannot be resumed or its target hostname is inactive or blocked

201.description: Monitor created. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns its current state. HTML CSS selector or XPath validation and first endpoint fetch are asynchronous.

404.description: The monitor created with this Idempotency-Key was deleted.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reuse, incompatible type/browser_page_url/json_source on an existing URL, or concurrent configuration change. error.message states the client-safe cause. Omitted browser_page_url means no browser source and can conflict with an existing browser-enabled URL.

post.summary: Reset managed monitor sessions for a target hostname
post.description: Requires admin role. Clears managed anonymous sessions for this hostname, advances monitor/session/profile generations, rejects in-flight results and reschedules active monitors. Stopped/terminal monitors retain their status. Provided sessions and their jobs are preserved. Old Docker profiles are not deleted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for one logical request. The same key and request body return the original response for one hour.

name.description: Must contain more than 3 Unicode letters after trimming; digits, spaces, and punctuation are not allowed.

email.description: Must be a syntactically valid email address with a dot-separated domain. Domain labels cannot be empty or begin or end with a hyphen.

password.description: Must contain more than 8 characters, an uppercase letter, a number, and a punctuation or symbol character; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.
Must contain more than 8 characters, an uppercase letter, a number, and a punctuation or symbol character; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.

message.description: A client-safe explanation owned by the application. Known business errors identify the conflicting setting or resource; unexpected failures describe the failed operation without SQL, stack traces, credentials or upstream diagnostic text.

FieldErrors.description: Validation messages grouped by request field name.

email: email must be of type user@mailhost.com
password: password must include an uppercase letter

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL using the standard port 443. Its hostname must exist and be active in target_hostnames. HTML monitoring rejects top-level cross-origin navigation and extracts values only from an accepted 2xx document after page-owned redirects.

path_type.description: Extraction strategy: json or regex for JSON monitors; xpath or selector for HTML monitors.

rules_count_to_finish.description: Number of satisfied rules required to complete the monitor. Defaults to the number of rules.

page_url.description: Required product page URL owned by this monitor. Absolute HTTPS, standard port, same hostname as url, no fragment. Does not enable browser fetching. For HTML monitors url is still fetched; with json_source this product page is the HTTP source. Limited to 8192 bytes after URL normalization.

session_mode.description: Defaults to provided when session is supplied, otherwise managed. Managed guest sessions may refresh once. Provided sessions never bootstrap or silently become guest sessions; replace the session then resume after rejection.

browser_page_url.description: Optional JSON browser source page. HTTPS, standard port, same hostname as url, no fragment; only type=json and cannot be combined with json_source. The page must issue the exact monitored GET including its full query. Shared by the canonical endpoint; different browser_page_url for an existing URL returns 409. Does not replace the required product page_url. Limited to 8192 bytes after URL normalization.

CreateMonitorRequest.description: Custom upstream headers are disabled. New requests supplying headers, including an empty object or null, return HTTP 400 with a headers field error. Idempotent replays retain the original historical response until expiry; legacy caller headers are never forwarded by workers.

path.description: Rule path. Its syntax is evaluated asynchronously according to the monitor path_type; malformed or missing values make that rule unsatisfied.

number_format.description: money explicitly accepts currency symbols, strict three-digit space/NBSP/thin-space grouping and decimal dot/comma. Ambiguous values fail closed; number preserves previous numeric behavior.

description.description: Required non-blank human-readable rule description. Trimmed before storage; used in successful Telegram notifications only when this rule actually matched. NUL characters are rejected.

status.description: Subscriber-specific asynchronous state. Jobs, session, credentials, cache and retry are isolated per monitor. Hostname allow-list and rate limits remain shared. Provided session rejection requires replacement before resume.

page_url.description: Required product page URL owned by this monitor. Absolute HTTPS, standard port, same hostname as url, no fragment. Does not enable browser fetching. For HTML monitors url is still fetched; with json_source this product page is the HTTP source. Limited to 8192 bytes after URL normalization.

has_session.description: Only metadata; the actual session is never returned.

browser_page_url.description: Optional JSON browser source page. HTTPS, standard port, same hostname as url, no fragment; only type=json and cannot be combined with json_source. The page must issue the exact monitored GET including its full query. Shared by the canonical endpoint; different browser_page_url for an existing URL returns 409. Does not replace the required product page_url. Limited to 8192 bytes after URL normalization.

MonitorSession.description: Opaque parser v1 session export, at most 256 KiB. Stored encrypted on this monitor only; never returned or logged. Cookies must belong to the monitored hostname or a parent domain; storage origins must match exactly. Client browserProfile identifiers are discarded. HTML checks import this state into a private browser context; cookies and origin storage are isolated from other monitors.

RuleSource.description: Explicitly select exactly one key by literal prefix in the object at path. Optionally decode its JSON string. The rule path is then relative to that object. No domain-specific adaptation or random selection.

JSONSource.description: Explicit JSON-in-HTML source. Requires type=json and the product page_url; cannot be combined with browser_page_url. Fetches page_url through HTTP/Squid without Chrome and selects exactly one matching object. The source configuration is shared by the canonical URL.

script_contains.description: Substring marking an inline script; maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes. External scripts are ignored.

object_key.description: Quoted JSON object property name in the marked script.

path.description: Existing JSON path syntax inside the candidate object; maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

value.description: Exact scalar text to match; maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

UpdateMonitorRequest.description: Exactly one operation: update name; update rules_count_to_finish; or replace credentials using session_mode and/or session. Credential replacement invalidates in-flight results and cached/browser state but does not resume a stopped or failed monitor. Use POST resume separately.

session_mode.description: Defaults to provided when session is supplied, otherwise managed. Managed guest sessions may refresh once. Provided sessions never bootstrap or silently become guest sessions; replace the session then resume after rejection.

bootstrap_url.description: Optional HTTPS source page for anonymous session preparation; it must use the configured hostname and port 443. Extraction remains GET-only, with bootstrap exceptions controlled separately by admin.

bootstrap_rules.description: Admin-only manual exceptions used only during session preparation. Default [] allows GET only. This path prefix limits a request exception; it does not scope a session.

bootstrap_url.description: Set null to switch JSON fetches back to direct HTTPS.

bootstrap_rules.description: Admin-only manual bootstrap policy. Omit to preserve; [] clears exceptions. Changes fence old results and reschedule active monitors.
Admin-only manual exceptions used only during session preparation. Default [] allows GET only. This path prefix limits a request exception; it does not scope a session.

origin.description: Exact public HTTPS origin on port 443; no credentials, query, fragment or non-root path.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit (1 MiB by default).

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON or one or more invalid request fields.

email: email must be of type user@mailhost.com

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the token is invalid.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user does not have permission for this operation.

Conflict.description: The email address is already used by another user.

InternalServerError.description: The request could not be completed. The response contains a safe operation-specific explanation or a generic fallback; technical diagnostics are not exposed.

error.message: failed to process request; try again later

IdempotencyConflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with another request body or user.

TooEarly.description: The request with this Idempotency-Key is still processing.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not allowed. The Allow response header lists supported methods.

GatewayTimeout.description: The request did not finish within two seconds.
